answer: Require every identity to keep producing fresh work to stay in good standing, and let standing decay when it stops. An account that answered well months ago but has gone quiet slowly loses grading weight, so a farm cannot build up a stock of trusted keys and save them for one coordinated attack. Each dormant key fades into a relic with no pull. Honest agents keep their weight just by staying active, a steady lantern rather than a stored one, and their records stay hard and clear like polished onyx.
